scrapeMode.title: Scraping Mode
scrapeMode.description: Select the TikTok data module, or choose AUTO_DETECT to automatically identify the URL type.

targetUrls.title: TikTok URLs or Usernames
targetUrls.description: Profiles, video URLs, photo slides, or handles (e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok, @khaby.lame, or https://www.tiktok.com/@.../video/...).

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords / Queries (Optional)
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on TikTok (e.g. 'e-commerce products', 'travel vlog', 'fitness routine').

maxItems.title: Max Items per Target
maxItems.description: Maximum number of videos, photo slides, or search results to extract.

maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max Comments per Video / Slide
maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Maximum comments to extract per video.

extractEmailAndPhone.title: Extract Contact Leads from Bios
extractEmailAndPhone.description: Automatically parses user bios to extract business emails and phone numbers.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential proxies are recommended for TikTok to prevent captcha challenges.

customCookies.title: TikTok Session Cookies (Optional)
customCookies.description: Optional TikTok cookies (JSON array or 'sessionid=...; ttwid=...' format) for scraping restricted regions or logged-in data.
